articles.title: The Insurance Rule That Keeps Doomed Beach Houses Standing
articles.summary: More than 30 homes have collapsed into the ocean in North Carolina since 2020. A FEMA rule pays owners only after a house falls — not before — so many wait instead of tearing them down. A fix is stalled in Congress.

articles.title: Chelsea's New Era: Clearlake Takes Full Control as Boehly Exits
articles.summary: Clearlake Capital has taken full control of Chelsea, ending Todd Boehly's chairmanship. The deal values the club at about £5 billion. Coach Xabi Alonso says the ambition is clear: win major trophies.

articles.title: Senate Advances Bill That Would Reshape College Sports
articles.summary: The Senate voted 74-24 to move forward on the Protect College Sports Act, which would set national rules for paying athletes, transfers, and lawsuits. It now heads toward a final vote.
